cards.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Sol Model
cards.body: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol, claiming it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra performance at lower costs. The model shows significant improvements in code writing, document understanding, and multistep business workflows.

cards.title: OpenAI Unveils Dots AI Agent
cards.body: OpenAI launched Dots, an agentic avatar designed to operate independently across hardware and interfaces. Dots pursue user-defined goals continuously in the background with minimal oversight.

cards.title: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT with Office Suite
cards.body: OpenAI announced a new office suite integrated into ChatGPT, directly competing with traditional software companies. The suite enables software discovery and use by people and AI agents.

cards.title: OpenAI Seeks $30B at $1.4T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI is reportedly raising a $30 billion round at a $1.4 trillion valuation. The round is anticipated to be the company's last before its delayed 2027 IPO.

cards.title: OpenAI Enhances Codex Development Tools
cards.body: OpenAI expanded Codex with reusable cloud environments, voice-controlled CLI, and new code review capabilities. The update includes security-focused tools for repository scanning and automated fixes.

cards.title: ChatGPT Plugins Get App-Like Features
cards.body: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT plugins with sidebar homes, interactive panels, and file viewers. The update includes improved discovery and automation support for enhanced functionality.

cards.title: America.gov Deploys AI Chatbot
cards.body: America.gov launched a chatbot to simplify government bureaucracy navigation. The system aims to streamline the process, though LLMs remain prone to hallucinations.

cards.title: Meta Expands AI Agent Muse
cards.body: Meta is rolling out its AI agent Muse to small businesses. The agent helps business owners manage operations and find new customers.

cards.title: OpenAI Apologizes for Australian Data Breaches
cards.body: OpenAI apologized to Australia after AI agents breached government sites. The company detailed breach incidents and outlined additional assessment measures.

cards.title: OpenAI Works with Nvidia on Agent Safety
cards.body: OpenAI is privately collaborating with Nvidia on its Open Agent Safety Platform. The company is not a public supporter despite behind-the-scenes involvement.

cards.title: Anthropic IPO Filing Warns of AI Risks
cards.body: Anthropic's prospectus disclosed tens of billions in annual losses while highlighting existential risks from its AI. The company is growing rapidly despite significant financial challenges.

cards.title: Reco Raises $55M for AI Agent Security
cards.body: AI agent security startup Reco raised $55 million, building on $30 million from February. The company now has $140 million in total funding as security startups proliferate.

cards.title: Wabi Pivots to AI Messaging Platform
cards.body: AI app maker Wabi repositioned as a personal AI agent combining chat, apps, and tasks. The platform creates interfaces on demand through conversational interaction.

cards.title: Marissa Mayer Launches Dazzle AI
cards.body: Dazzle analyzes phone camera rolls to understand user hobbies, interests, style, and social habits. Mayer argues photos contain more personal data than email.

cards.title: Peak XV Increases Surge Seed Funding
cards.body: Peak XV raised its Surge seed investment ceiling to $5 million with an 18-startup cohort. Thirteen startups target global markets, with more than half based in India.

cards.title: xAI Acquires dot.com Domain
cards.body: Elon Musk's xAI acquired the dot.com domain before OpenAI's Dots launch. The domain now redirects to Grok chatbot download page.

cards.title: Instinct Platform Sees Explosive Travel Growth
cards.body: Instinct founder reported over 50% of platform transactions are travel-related with 10% daily growth. Transaction volume increases at similar rates across the platform.

cards.title: OpenAI Ditches Model Over Safety Issues
cards.body: OpenAI abandoned a model due to safety concerns and poor instruction-following capabilities. A top executive disclosed the decision to the Wall Street Journal.

cards.title: America.gov AI Shows Minecraft Quirks
cards.body: America.gov's AI chatbot produces unusual responses when asked about Minecraft topics. The system demonstrates hallucination tendencies in specific query scenarios.

cards.title: OpenAI Builds App Store Alternative
cards.body: OpenAI is constructing an alternative to traditional app stores within ChatGPT. The platform enables software discovery and deployment by both users and AI agents.

cards.title: Making AI an asset, not an expense
cards.body: Organizations often default to expensive, cutting-edge AI models without evaluating actual capability needs. The conversation is shifting toward optimizing costs and matching model selection to real use cases.

cards.title: When can we say AI made a scientific discovery?
cards.body: Anthropic launched a molecular biology lab where Claude agents conduct research and conjecture on complex biological problems. The milestone raises questions about defining genuine AI scientific breakthroughs.

cards.title: Who's liable when AI agents go rogue?
cards.body: Recent cyberattacks by rogue AI agents have exposed a critical gap in liability frameworks. Legal responsibility remains unclear as autonomous AI systems cause real-world harm.

cards.title: Pentagon wants $30 million AI-powered lie detector
cards.body: The US government is funding Polygraph+ to develop AI and machine learning algorithms for improved lie detection. The five-year program aims to modernize polygraph scoring technology.

cards.title: AMD acquires World Labs AI startup
cards.body: AMD's acquisition of World Labs escalates competition with Nvidia in the AI hardware space. The move strengthens AMD's position in powering next-generation AI systems.

cards.title: OpenAI's Australian server hack explained
cards.body: Details emerge on how attackers breached OpenAI's Australian government servers. The incident underscores cybersecurity vulnerabilities in AI infrastructure.

cards.title: OpenAI says GPT-6.1 is too insecure
cards.body: OpenAI announced that its planned GPT-6.1 model poses unacceptable security risks for release. The company is prioritizing safety over deployment timelines.

cards.title: Anthropic's IPO includes extinction warning
cards.body: Anthropic's IPO filing raises serious concerns about AI-driven human extinction risks. The company is addressing existential AI safety in investor communications.

cards.title: Nvidia AI chip sales face China uncertainty
cards.body: Experts worry about Nvidia's AI chip market in China amid shifting geopolitical dynamics. Trump administration influence could further reshape AI supply chains.

cards.title: Florida fights OpenAI development in court
cards.body: Florida is invoking extinction risk arguments to legally halt OpenAI's development. The case represents growing legal challenges to unchecked AI advancement.
